I found a shop of Oxford University Press!
As soon as I found this, I visited the shop and enjoy viewing books of mathematics. It is not easy to find a book of math that satisfies me, but I thought this shop must have some kind of the books. And I finally find a pretty nice book of math. Yay!!
By the way, I was asked by the staff "Do you have student ID?" LOL

No, I was just a visitor enjoying sightseeing. Okay, let's just say it is extremely rare to a visitor to enjoy shopping this shop.
